rationale: MSFT is deeply oversold (4h RSI 23, 1h RSI 27, stoch 19, bb%b 0.09) inside a very strong ADX-62 downtrend, and the last ~12 candles show a small, thin bounce already underway off 386.6 up to 389.9 holding above 384.31 support. Shorting here is the account's worst pattern - chasing stretched-oversold tape a routine counter-bounce would stop out. But longing a low-volume bounce against a dominant downtrend into 406 resistance, with earnings Jul 29 as looming binary risk, is not clean enough (no divergence, thin volume) to size. Wait for a reclaim confirming the reversal or a support break confirming continuation.

reconsider.note: Losing 384.31 support voids the oversold bounce and confirms the ADX-62 downtrend resumes - flips to a short with a stop back above VWAP.

Bias: shorts on earnings losers better supported than crowded longs; fade extensions.

transcript.analyst: Composite says short but that's a lagging read of the 1h/4h downtrend; candles show an oversold bounce already underway (386.6 -> 389.9, holding above 384.31 support, 5m up). Shorting into RSI 23 / stoch 18 / bb%b 0.09 with price bouncing off VWAP = late short, stopped by the bounce. But the bounce is thin/low-volume against ADX-62 downtrend into 406 resistance, no divergence - not a clean long either. HOLD; short on loss of 384.31, long only on a ~392-393 reclaim.
